mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS "resourceId", d.code AS "code", d.name AS "name", di.ip AS "ip", c.code AS "capability", dev.icon AS "icon", (SELECT p.id FROM resource_node p WHERE p.id = d.parent_id AND p.kind = 'island') AS "islandId", (SELECT p.code FROM resource_node p WHERE p.id = d.parent_id AND p.kind = 'island') AS "islandCode" FROM resource_node d JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dev ON dev.id = di.device_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dev.capability_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{param1} AND d.kind = 'device' AND (#{param2}::bigint IS NULL OR d.parent_id = #{param2}) ORDER BY d.code

SELECT d.id AS "resourceId", d.code AS "code", d.name AS "name", di.ip AS "ip", c.code AS "capability" FROM resource_node d LEFT JOIN resource_node p ON p.id = d.parent_id LEFT JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = d.id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN device dev ON dev.id = di.device_id LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = dev.capability_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{param1} AND d.kind = 'device' AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.kind <> 'island') AND di.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.code
